policy: Deferred evidence remains truthfully open. Owner scope acceptance may remove an item as a v0.4.0 release blocker only when the item is explicitly marked accepted_for_v0_4_scope=true; no evidence status is promoted by that acceptance.

items.implemented_surface: cross-harness self-service parity runner + static Hermes/Codex/Gemini/Copilot skill exports
items.completion_criterion: Reviewed live multi-harness evidence executes the same task/input/constraints/skill across at least two real installed harnesses and is intentionally promoted into the canonical record.
items.safe_next_action: User runs the self-service parity harness on installed/authenticated runtimes, then submits bounded evidence for review.

items.implemented_surface: Cognee HTTP self-service eight-case memory runner
items.completion_criterion: Reviewed live Cognee/Hermes provider run completes the canonical eight-case contract with evidence and zero false-success.
items.safe_next_action: User configures an isolated Cognee endpoint and explicitly runs the memory self-test; reviewed provider evidence is promoted separately.

items.completion_criterion: Reviewed live Browser Use provider/agent run completes the same canonical six browser cases before any Playwright-vs-Browser-Use comparison claim.
items.safe_next_action: User installs/configures Browser Use and explicitly runs the disposable six-case self-test; reviewed live evidence is promoted separately.

items.implemented_surface: hash-chained recorder + fail-closed audit/merge/prepare baseline tooling
items.completion_criterion: At least 20 eligible direct non-generated real tasks with complete evidence, independent verification, redaction review, and zero false-successes reach READY_FOR_REPORT.
items.safe_next_action: Collect genuine user work through the recorder; preserve failures and do not bulk-import synthetic fixtures, PR bodies, or commit history.

items.implemented_surface: multi-role workforce, approval, verification, memory, provider and task evidence infrastructure
items.completion_criterion: At least one evidence-backed real workflow is demonstrated for each major department included in the intended release claim.
items.safe_next_action: Accumulate genuine department workflows through the real-task recorder rather than generating benchmark substitutes.

items.implemented_surface: deterministic one-worker, subset, full-workforce, and upgrade/uninstall/reinstall isolated matrices
items.completion_criterion: The intended release environment completes a real clean-machine Hermes install/upgrade/uninstall/reinstall lifecycle and the final release gate is rerun from the final promoted commit.
items.safe_next_action: Run the documented lifecycle on a clean intended release machine when the owner chooses to supply that environment.

non_evidence_scope_items.note: Live ads provider adapters, original art for ten newer workers, and complete office/UI storage migration remain separate product-scope gaps and are not converted into evidence completion by this ledger.

owner_scope_note: Owner explicitly accepted these still-open evidence classes as bounded deferred scope for v0.4.0 stable promotion. Canonical evidence states are not upgraded.
